name: What is the difference between a minor kitchen refresh and a full renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a minor kitchen refresh and a full renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A minor kitchen refresh typically involves cosmetic updates without changing the layout, such as repainting cabinets, upgrading hardware, replacing countertops, or installing new appliances. It's less disruptive and generally more budget-friendly. A full renovation, in contrast, often includes altering the kitchen's layout, moving walls, relocating plumbing and electrical, and installing all new components, offering a complete transformation of the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A minor refresh involves cosmetic updates without layout changes, while a full renovation alters the layout, plumbing, electrical, and replaces all major components for a complete transformation.
